description: Synthetic morphine in a grey gelcap. The pain goes away. So does everything else.

overdose.message: Your breathing slows, and slows, and stops.

phases.comeup_message: Warmth spreads up from your feet. Nothing hurts.
phases.end_message: The warmth goes, and you feel cold and lonely.
peak_message: The pain stops, all of it, all at once.
Warmth spreads through you and the pain goes.
There is nothing wrong with you. There never was.

withdrawal.message: Your skin crawls and your bones ache. All you want is more grey.

stages.easing: The pain backs off a little. It's still there.
stages.onset: A cold patch settles between your shoulder blades and stays.
stages.peak: All the pain the grey was blocking is back at once, and worse than before.
stages.rising: Every joint aches. Nothing's injured. It all just hurts.
stages.tail: You can get through the day, but part of you is always waiting for the pain to come back.

name: grey
